features.name: Data Events
features.expected: Registers an altimeter reading-changed event listener; Enable starts it, Disable stops it. Altitude change(m) updates as readings arrive. Hardware-gated: with no altimeter present the status reads 'No altimeter found' and Disable is disabled.

features.name: Polling
features.expected: Polls the altimeter once via GetDefault/GetCurrentReading on Get Data and displays the altitude change. Hardware-gated: with no altimeter present the status reads 'No altimeter found' and Get Data is disabled.
